note: Cross-cutting decoder negative test scenarios (see also the malformed/negative sections inside compact.json, bool.json, bytes.json, option.json, result.json, variant.json). This file lists reader/writer-level transactional guarantees that apply across components.

cases.description: scale_write_u64 with a 4-byte buffer must return SCALE_ERROR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL and leave writer.offset at 0.
scale_read_u32 on a 2-byte input must return SCALE_ERROR_UNEXPECTED_EOF and leave reader.offset at 0.
scale_read_compact_u32 decoding a valid Compact<u64> encoding of 2^32 must return SCALE_ERROR_OVERFLOW and leave reader.offset unchanged (not partially consumed).
